opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based organisations; individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution are not eligible; projects led by schools, colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, or for PhD fees are excluded; local charities and overseas organisations are generally not eligible.
opportunities.summary: The Main Grants fund (Research, Development and Analysis Fund) offers up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases) for research addressing the Foundation’s priority questions, with two annual deadlines (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applications from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, especially partnerships between researchers and those communities; UK‑based applicants are expected.
opportunities.summary: The Racial Diversity UK Fund supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes and challenges, with a priority theme for 2026 on generational shifts in outlooks, experiences and conditions.
